responsibility: This header declares the C6X backend entry points implemented in c6x.cc that are referenced from the machine description, target macros, and other target support code. Its prototypes cover calling convention setup, address legitimacy and memory operands, move/call/compare expansion, cpymem support, subword helpers, prologue/epilogue generation, register-class queries, option overrides, unwind emission, and function-finalization hooks, making it the exported interface for the C6X target implementation.
